name: Beijing Luzhu Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Luzhu Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is a biotechnology company developing human vaccines and therapeutic biologics in mainland China, aimed at preventing infectious diseases and treating cancer and autoimmune conditions. Its candidates include LZ901, a recombinant herpes zoster vaccine, and K3, a recombinant anti-TNF-alpha monoclonal antibody injection.
